mfa.status.onSms: You confirm each sign-in with a code sent by text message.
mfa.status.onCodesNote: Recovery codes are shown only once, when multi-factor authentication is set up.
mfa.status.offHelp: Set up an authenticator app to add a second step when you sign in.
mfa.status.unavailable: Setup is not available for your account right now.
mfa.status.pendingSms: This pending text-message setup can only be cancelled here.
mfa.enroll.introduction: You need an authenticator app on another device, such as your phone.
mfa.enroll.stepStart: Start setup to get a QR code and a setup key.
mfa.enroll.stepScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key.
mfa.enroll.stepCode: Enter the six-digit code that your authenticator app shows.
mfa.verify.introduction: Add MIA to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
mfa.setup.qrLabel: QR code for adding MIA to your authenticator app
mfa.setup.manualHelp: If you cannot scan the QR code, enter these values in your authenticator app.
mfa.setup.hiddenHelp: The QR code and setup key were hidden while you were away. Show them again when no one else can see your screen.
mfa.setup.notShown: The QR code and setup key for this setup cannot be shown again. If you already added MIA to your authenticator app, enter its current code. Otherwise, cancel this setup and start again.
mfa.setup.uriRejected: MIA received setup data it cannot use, so no QR code or setup key is shown. Cancel this setup and start again.
mfa.verify.codeLabel: Six-digit code from your authenticator app (required)
mfa.verify.codeHelp: Enter the code that is currently shown. Leading zeros count.
mfa.verify.noPending: There is no pending setup to verify.
mfa.outcome.codeInvalid: That code was not accepted. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
mfa.outcome.setupGone: This setup has ended. It may have expired or received too many incorrect codes. Start a new setup.
mfa.outcome.codesLost: Multi-factor authentication is now on, but the recovery codes from this setup could not be shown. They cannot be retrieved. Only a future replacement of this factor issues new codes.
mfa.outcome.verifyUnknownPending: We could not confirm whether your code was accepted. The setup is still pending, so you can enter a new code.
mfa.outcome.verifyRejected: Your code could not be checked.
mfa.outcome.notSent: The request was not sent. Check your connection and try again.
mfa.outcome.throttled: There have been too many attempts. Wait a while before trying again.
mfa.outcome.startUnknownPending: We could not confirm the setup response. A setup is pending, but its QR code and setup key cannot be shown.
mfa.outcome.startUnknownNone: Setup did not start. You can start again.
mfa.outcome.pendingExists: A setup is already pending. Continue it or cancel it before starting again.
mfa.outcome.cancelRejected: The setup could not be cancelled.
mfa.outcome.cancelUnknownPending: We could not confirm whether the setup was cancelled. It is still pending, so you can cancel it again.
mfa.outcome.cancelUnknownGone: The setup is no longer pending.
mfa.outcome.checkFailed: We could not check your multi-factor authentication status.
mfa.codes.warning: Each code works once if you cannot use your authenticator app. MIA shows these codes only now and cannot show them again. MIA cannot remove copies from your clipboard, screenshots, print queue, or paper.
mfa.codes.copyFailure: Recovery codes could not be copied. Select and copy them manually.
mfa.codes.printInitiated: Print dialog requested. Printing is not confirmed.
mfa.codes.printFailure: Printing could not start. Copy the codes or write them down.
mfa.codes.acknowledge: I have saved my recovery codes
mfa.codes.acknowledgeHelp: Store them somewhere safe and private. You will not see them again.
mfa.codes.acknowledgeFirst: Confirm that you saved your recovery codes first.
mfa.codes.hiddenHelp: Your recovery codes were hidden while you were away. Show them again when no one else can see your screen.
mfa.codes.unavailable: Recovery codes are no longer available. They are shown only once and cannot be retrieved. Only a future replacement of this factor issues new codes.
shell.navigation.label: Application
invitations.discard.title: Discard this invitation?
invitations.discard.description: The email address you entered has not been sent. If you leave this page, it is discarded.
invitations.list.heading: Invitations
invitations.create.heading: Invite a supervisor
invitations.detail.heading: Invitation details
invitations.resend.heading: Resend invitation
invitations.revoke.heading: Revoke invitation
invitations.checkFailed: Invitation information could not be loaded. Check again, or use an available exit.
invitations.unavailable.heading: Not available
invitations.unavailable.body: It may not exist, or you may not have access to it.
invitations.delivery.queuedHelp: MIA has admitted the email for sending but has not recorded a result yet. It may not have been sent.
invitations.delivery.deliveredHelp: The mail server accepted the email. This does not confirm that it arrived or was read.
invitations.delivery.ambiguousHelp: MIA could not confirm whether the email was sent. The invitation is still usable, and MIA does not retry automatically. You can resend it.
invitations.delivery.failedHelp: The mail server definitively rejected the email. This invitation cannot be used.
invitations.delivery.lifecycleNeutral: MIA recorded the delivery state at the time of the last update. The current state may have changed.
invitations.delivery.code.timeout: the mail server did not answer in time
invitations.delivery.code.ambiguous: the mail server’s answer was inconclusive
invitations.delivery.code.rejected: the mail server rejected the email
invitations.summary.heading: Invitation
invitations.list.introduction: Invitations you can manage, with their persisted status and latest delivery. MIA sends no notifications when these change; use Refresh.
invitations.list.caption: Invitations
invitations.empty.heading: No invitations
invitations.empty.body: No invitations are available to you yet.
invitations.emptyPage.heading: No invitations on this page
invitations.emptyPage.body: Use Previous to return to earlier invitations.
invitations.list.loadFailed: The invitation list could not be loaded
invitations.showingOld: The information shown is from the last successful check and may be out of date.
invitations.checkStateFailed: The current state could not be checked
invitations.stateUnchanged: Checked. The invitation state has not changed.
invitations.noActions: No actions are available for an invitation in this state.
invitations.faultyHelp: This invitation cannot be used or resent. To invite this address again, create a new invitation.
invitations.nothingChanged: MIA did not make this change. You can try again.
invitations.create.introduction: MIA emails an invitation link to this address. The invited person chooses a username and password when accepting. No account exists until then.
invitations.email.label: Supervisor’s email address
invitations.email.help: The invitation is for the supervisor role. Use an address that has no MIA account and no pending invitation.
invitations.email.tooLong: Enter an email address of at most 254 characters.
invitations.email.invalid: MIA did not accept this email address. Check it and try again.
invitations.email.conflict: This address already has a MIA account or a pending invitation. No new invitation was created.
invitations.created.heading: Invitation created
invitations.created.body: MIA created a pending supervisor invitation. Email delivery is queued: MIA has not confirmed that the email was sent or read, and no account exists until the invitation is accepted.
invitations.notCreated.help: Nothing was created. Your entry is kept, so you can try again.
invitations.createUnknown.heading: Invitation not confirmed
invitations.createUnknown.body: MIA could not confirm whether the invitation was created. Do not assume it was sent. Review the invitation list. A new attempt for the same address is rejected if the earlier one exists.
invitations.resend.consequence: MIA sends a new link to the same address. Any link sent earlier stops working immediately. MIA does not retry automatically.
invitations.resent.heading: Invitation resent
invitations.resent.body: MIA admitted a new link for delivery, and the earlier link no longer works. The delivery state shown is the latest MIA has recorded; it does not confirm that the email was read.
invitations.resend.notPending: This invitation is no longer pending, so it cannot be resent. Its current state is shown.
invitations.resend.unknown: MIA could not confirm whether the invitation was resent. The earlier link may no longer work, and the delivery state is unknown. MIA does not retry automatically. Check the current state before deciding again.
invitations.resend.unknownReconciled: The current state is shown. It does not confirm whether the earlier resend happened.
invitations.notResent.heading: Invitation not resent
invitations.revoke.consequence: The invitation record is kept and marked revoked. Its link stops working immediately and cannot be used to create an account. This cannot be undone.
invitations.revoked.heading: Invitation revoked
invitations.revoked.body: The invitation is kept as revoked. Its link no longer works.
invitations.revoke.changed: The invitation changed since you reviewed it, so MIA made no change. Review its current state before deciding again.
invitations.notRevoked.heading: Invitation not revoked
invitations.revoke.unknown: MIA could not confirm whether the invitation was revoked. MIA does not retry automatically. Check the current state.
invitations.revoke.notConfirmed: The current state is shown. It does not confirm whether the earlier attempt revoked the invitation. Any new revocation needs a new review.
invitations.revoke.notPending: Only a pending invitation can be revoked. This invitation’s current state is shown.
tutoring.draftLeaveHelp: Leaving discards the unsent message. It stays only in this page’s memory and is never saved; nothing will be restored when you return.
